title: dianthus integer subsp. minutiflorus
intro: Dianthus integer subsp. minutiflorus, commonly known as the small-flowered pink or small-flowered fringed pink, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carnation family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus integer subsp. minutiflorus include its ability to act as a nervine, which may help to calm the nervous system, and its antispasmodic properties, which may help to relieve muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
